title: Baby-universe state dependence of the wormhole-induced gravi-axion mass gap
summary: Euclidean wormholes can break the axion shift symmetry, and when this symmetry is broken, a periodic potential is created for the axion, and the curvature of this potential at a minimum point can give the axion mass. In this work, we take seriously the assumption that the mere existence of a wormhole does not mean that the axion mass is uniquely determined, and that more information is needed to determine it.
